needs_review.issue: Spouse named only in body text, not in slug or title
needs_review.finding: The page https://focus.org/missionaries/katie-moran/ is titled 'Katie Moran' and the snippet says she 'and her husband Joe spent the past 7 years as a missionary family at the University of Alabama'.
needs_review.recommendation: Per the wave brief's couple grading table, a spouse named in neither slug nor title is not emitted. If a reviewer can open the page, 'Joe Moran' is likely a second Tier A record on the same URL.

needs_review.issue: Slug surname does not match title surname
needs_review.finding: https://focus.org/missionaries/annie-blanchard is titled 'Annie Lugo - FOCUS' while the body text refers to 'Annie Blanchard' serving at Florida Atlantic and Miami.
needs_review.evidence: Search result title vs. slug on the Miami/FAU/Tampa query
needs_review.recommendation: Emitted as 'Annie Lugo' at medium confidence. A reviewer should confirm the current surname and whether the record should carry 'Blanchard' as an alias.

needs_review.issue: Teammates and a fiancee cited by first name only
needs_review.finding: https://focus.org/missionaries/ava-gideon/ lists teammates 'Nathan, Jack, Madeline, Shields, Jillian, Mark and Colleen'; https://focus.org/missionaries/shields-haire/ names a fiancee 'Madeline'; https://focus.org/missionaries/miah-monson/ lists teammates 'Nik, Alex, Logan, Gabi and Brianna'.
needs_review.evidence: Search snippets on the Carolinas and Florida queries
needs_review.recommendation: Not emitted - first-name-only fragments, and a fiancee is not a spouse on a shared giving page. These are page-finder leads for a name-axis agent, not records.

needs_review.issue: Northeast campuses appear largely unindexed under the site: operator
needs_review.finding: Boston College, Providence, UMass, UNH, Rutgers, Princeton, Villanova, Fordham, Syracuse and Catholic University of America returned no focus.org/missionaries personal pages across four separate queries, while Mid-Atlantic and South campuses returned 6-10 personal pages per query.
needs_review.recommendation: Either FOCUS has thin coverage at those specific campuses or those profile pages are not indexed. A future wave should reach them by first name or by team-role phrasing rather than by campus name; campus-name queries for the Northeast are spent ground.

needs_review.issue: University of Georgia, Georgia Southern, UCF, USF, UNC and NC State produced no personal pages
needs_review.finding: Two dedicated queries covering these campuses returned only third-party sites (focusoncampus.org, diocesan campus-ministry pages) and no focus.org/missionaries URLs.
needs_review.recommendation: Do not re-buy these campus-name queries. Reach these campuses via a different axis.
